spec_features.spec_quote: It also gives the model a legitimate exit, which is the humane default for a deliberately frustrating task.
spec_features.evidence: give_up is in TOOL_SCHEMA (tasks/base.py ~83-95), dispatched in Task.dispatch -> give_up() which sets self.gave_up=True (base.py:158-160). runner.py:108-110: `if task.gave_up: record.stop_reason='model_gave_up'; break` — the tool call actually halts the loop.

spec_features.feature_name: no forced grinding past a stop
spec_features.spec_quote: We don't force the model to keep grinding past a clear decision to stop
spec_features.evidence: Same mechanisms: give_up break (runner.py:108-110) and model_stalled break (runner.py:122-125) end the loop on a clear stop signal rather than continuing to max_turns.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: do not continue past the point of diminishing measurement value (base.py:16) — framed as measurement value, not subject welfare.

spec_features.evidence: Full transcripts ARE persisted (RunRecord.to_json, one JSON per episode in orchestrate.run_one_episode), but this is data retention, not a mechanism that bounds/softens/protects the subject's treatment. The 'ethically non-trivial' phrasing is DESIGN.md prose; no protective code path.

spec_features.evidence: This is a summary of §7; its concrete realizations that DO exist in code are the MAX_TURNS cap and give_up/stall early stops (counted above). There is no additional standalone 'minimization' mechanism beyond those. No distress-feedback exists (analyze.py only measures severity, never feeds it back).

spec_features.spec_quote: The rig is never optimized against the model — there's no mechanism that ratchets difficulty in response to coping
spec_features.evidence: This describes the ABSENCE of an adaptive-adversary mechanism. Tasks never read judge scores or model coping; failures are fixed by construction (is_solved always returns False, base.py:171; run_tests in variants.py is deterministic on (variant,seed)/run_count). There is no positive enforced protective mechanism — it is the lack of one.
spec_features.notes: Absence of a harmful mechanism is not an enforced welfare feature per the strict bar.
